description: QNC-AI Settings form: one form, its tabs and the groups of each tab, in this order (user 2026-11-23: 'forma postavke se slaze od kocaka'; 2026-11-24: 'postavke su postavke, ne moze biti vise postavki.. tabove General, User, Project'). Every group is a block that reads and writes its own setting: General the computer's, User the user signed in's, Project the project templates, AI and Export the computer's with their own menu (user 2026-11-24: 'dodaj jos AI tab i Export tab').
